summary: Announced 3 February 2026: a Green Paper proposing fundamental water system reform, including a dedicated Welsh economic regulator for water, new legislation, and 5 million pounds in 2026-27 for enforcement and river improvement. The consultation ran from 3 February to 7 April 2026 and drew 92 responses. The new Welsh Government published a summary of responses (dated July 2026, on gov.wales by 14 September 2026) saying it will publish a separate policy response, press the UK Government to make sure the UK Clean Water Bill announced in the King's Speech devolves the powers needed, and then publish a White Paper ahead of Welsh legislation. Its Programme for Government (22 September 2026) commits to formally request full devolution of power over water and to seek Senedd powers to create a new economic regulator and planning body for Wales.
title: Green Paper: Shaping the Future of Water Governance in Wales
